text: Fees 1. Tuition fee: CNY 9,200/student/semester 2. Application payment: USD 50/student 3. Boarding cost: CNY 6,800/student/semester 4. Deposit: CNY 800/student (will be returned when the student leaves) 5. Tuition Rates for teaching materials: CNY 400/student/semester 6. Insurance: CNY 90/student/year 7. Rates for food: not included 8. This Chinese Language Program is supported by Chinese Education fundation , the excellence will be honored by prizes. Purposes of this Program After two years study, successful students will be competent in Chinese language and Chinese culture, which are sought after professional talents in the modern international society. They will pass Grade 6 of HSK and qualified students will get a professional certificate which is recognised by the Chinese government. These professional certificates also allow successful students to go on to study for their bachelor’s degrees in the Overseas Chinese University (Hua Qiao University). Curriculum The College enrolls students at both spring and fall semesters, in February and September. Students may apply at any time of the year Grade Curriculum Grade Grade One (Elementary Level) Intensive Reading in Chinese, Extensive Reading in Chinese, Chinese Speaking and Listening Comprehension, Writing of Chinese Characters, music, sports Grade One (Elementary Level) Grade Two (Intermediate level) Modern Chinese, intermediate Chinese Speaking and Listening Comprehension, Extensive Reading, Commercial Chinese, Chinese Composition, Reading of Selected Newspaper and Magazine Articles Grade Two (Intermediate level) According to the requirements of the “Summary of Chinese language teaching to high school foreign students”, students will master 2,036 common Chinese words (written and spoken) and 4,919 phrases.
